statements.text: Well, we remember what happened up in New Hampshire, when people using AI replicated the voice of Joe Biden, and put things out over the air that were not true. We've already seen some of that taking place here in South Carolina regarding the Republican primary, inviting Democrats into the primary, saying things over the air that just are not true. And that is going to happen over and over again, throughout all of these states. And I do believe it will be very, very prevalent in the general election this year.

This government shutdown is now the longest in American history.

Federal employees are still furloughed or working without pay, funding for essential programs has run out, and 20 million Americans are staring down health care premiums that have doubled.

And what is the President doing? Posting memes and AI videos. Hosting a lavish Great Gatsby–themed Halloween party.

I’ve never seen a President so consumed by his own interests that he cannot focus on the urgent needs of the American people.

It’s truly astonishing.

As your electricity bill goes up, remember—it doesn’t have to be this way.

Democrats invested in expanding clean energy to lower costs.

Trump killed those investments to protect costly fossil fuels, just as AI data centers drive demand even higher.
https://t.co/kME4J3ieT0

Trump launches tariffs➡️prices increase, companies get refunds

Trump embraces big AI companies➡️energy prices increase, corporations benefit

Trump attacks Iran➡️gas prices increase, oil companies benefit

When is Trump going to do something that benefits the American people?

I have a great staff. I wish I could know everything. I don't know everything, and I don't spend my time trying to learn everything. What I spend my time doing is trying to surround myself with people who do know stuff. I know how to legislate. I know how to build relationships, and I hire people to bring knowledge into the game that I can put to practice.

statements.text:
Some of our top military leaders are now warning Trump that his war in Iran is compromising military readiness in other parts of the world and seriously risking our national security.

Meanwhile, the President is posting fake AI-generated videos of attacks on Iran, and your gas prices are still up.

Trump might think this is all a game, but his dumb decisions are having real consequences for the rest of us.https://t.co/lRF6eZ1jl1

Just to recap what we have very recently learned about Trump, his administration, and his family:

Trump thinks concerns over AI are a “hoax” and rejected calls to regulate it.

Trump’s son had his wedding parties paid for by a Russian oligarch with close ties to Putin and is sanctioned by Ukraine for his role in abducting Ukrainian children.

Trump’s EPA repealed all federal limits on greenhouse-gas emissions from coal- and gas-fired power plants.

Detainees at “Alligator Alcatraz” were punished by being shackled and forced into small cages for up to two hours.

Criminals are paying hundreds of thousands of dollars to politically connected pardon brokers who use their influence to secure pardons from President Trump.

The list goes on. This administration is out of control.

Gas prices are surging due to a failed war in Iran, the Attorney General says we should not try to regulate AI, and the President of the United States is blaming Democrats for his 2024 assassination attempt.

Just another day in Trump’s America. https://t.co/Olg8G34Wn9
You cannot read this and think this is a person capable of understanding or caring about the very serious threat AI poses. https://t.co/zBWk1yqBzP

The American people should never forget that when they faced exploding costs from a failed war in Iran and dangerous uncertainty from unchecked artificial intelligence, House Republicans decided to cancel work in Washington and go home for nearly eight weeks.

Shameful.

There you have it.

Trump doesn’t want any safeguards on AI because he’s concerned they would cause the stock market to go down under his watch.

This is Covid-19 all over again: faced with credible warnings of a threat to the American people, Trump sticks his head in the sand and pretends it’s not happening.
https://t.co/isIZlfmEAm

Leaders of the world’s largest AI companies are calling for slower development because they fear “superintelligence” could cause catastrophic harm.

Trump is openly encouraging it while rejecting new safeguards.

It is not an exaggeration to say that Trump is gambling our economy, our national security, and the safety of the American people just because he’s worried about the stock market falling under his watch.
